sources.title: SafeStep AI: HSE Auditor | Devpost
sources.snippet: What it does SafeStep AI is a specialized HSE auditing dashboard that analyzes industrial environments in real-time: 🛡️ PPE DETECTION: Scans for helmets, vests, and safety gear with high accuracy. ⚠️ HAZARD IDENTIFICATION: Flags critical violations, such as workers positioned beneath suspended loads.
